messages:
lee: Heads-up - rotation planned for alias/customer-data-prod tomorrow 04:00 UTC. Concern: DSAR proof generator needs decrypt access for archived blobs.
olga: Can we do a scoped, short-lived decrypt grant to the dsar-runner during rotation? Prefer role with condition on source IP and tag.
dave: We'll also need to export any proofs that are in-flight within a 4h window before rotation. I'll produce an export manifest and upload to secure bucket.
lee: +1 for adding kms_request_id into evidence manifest so we can show the exact decrypt call. Keystore-proxy already returns X-KMS-Request-Id header.
privacy-bot: Legal asks: exclude any records with retention_exception=true and include rotation_reason in manifest.
olga: RBAC plan: create role dsar-temp-decrypt-<ts> with only keystore:Decrypt on alias/customer-data-prod, session max 1h, auto-delete policy after 90m.
dave: I'll add filter in export job: skip retention_exception, include pending and retry states. Export path s3://redwood-dsar-exports/pre-2850000000/.
lee: Canary step: run 10 randomized decrypts against archived blobs; fail-to-rotate if any fail. I'll write the script.
olga: Alerting: temporary rule during window: sum(rate(keystore.decrypt_denied[5m])) > 3 => page eng-oncall + privacy.
lee: Runbook owners: lee (canary & monitor), olga (RBAC), dave (export & manifest). Post ticket and tag @eng-oncall before proceeding.
privacy-bot: DSAR runbook updated: required fields: dsar_id, requestor_email, kms_request_id, rotation_reason, legal_ticket.
